column1: # PAM lab: one row per guest, whitespace-separated, "-" = default.
#   name    Proxmox VM name (letters, digits, dot, hyphen)
#   node    Proxmox node that imports and runs it
#   ova     file in LAB_OVA_DIR on that node (or an absolute path);
#           "-" = not an OVA, the row is only managed by lab-ctl.sh
#   bridge  SDN vnet or bridge for net0
#   memory  MiB          (- = what the OVF says)
#   cores   vCPU         (- = what the OVF says)
#   ostype  l26 | win10 | win11 | other   (Proxmox ostype)
#   flags   comma list: efi bios tpm keepmac nosnap sata ide scsi e1000 e1000e virtio vmxnet3
# Order matters: lab-ctl.sh starts guests top to bottom and stops them bottom to top.
# vmid  name     node  ova                          bridge  memory  cores  ostype  flags
# More appliances go below. These are templates, not real rows: uncomment and
# fill in only for OVAs you actually have.
